description: List bundles — pre-priced sets of products sold together for less than buying the parts separately (an instrument plus the accessories normally needed with it). Each result gives the set price, what the parts would cost separately, the saving, and exactly what is included. Good for "what do I need to get started" questions, where recommending one set beats listing five separate products.

brand.description: Restrict by brand name, partial match.

in_stock.description: true = only sets where every included item is in stock.

language.description: Locale for text + pricing (ro=RON, hu=HUF, de/en=EUR). Default ro.

query.description: Optional text match on the set or brand name.
